# Naviamp 2.12.1

Naviamp 2.12.1 keeps Jellyfin signed in on every device you use, and restores Jellyfin 12 playback when tracks are converted for streaming.

## Bug fixes

- Signing in to Jellyfin on a second device, such as a phone and an Android TV, no longer signs out the first. Every Naviamp installation on the same platform introduced itself to Jellyfin with the same device name, and Jellyfin ends that device's earlier sessions each time you sign in. Each installation now has its own identity, kept on that device and never included in settings exports or backups. Reported by [@tobycell12-beep](https://github.com/tobycell12-beep). ([Issue #730](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/730), [hotfix PR #731](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/731))
- Play converted (transcoded) tracks from Jellyfin 12 servers again. Jellyfin 12 turns off a legacy sign-in method by default, and Naviamp still used it on streaming links, so the server rejected those streams with "Invalid token." Naviamp now uses the method current Jellyfin servers accept, which earlier Jellyfin versions also support. Reported by [@tobycell12-beep](https://github.com/tobycell12-beep). ([Issue #730](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/730), [hotfix PR #731](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/731))

## Upgrade notes

- Jellyfin connections that are still signed in keep working after the update.
- If Jellyfin already signed out one of your devices, open Connections on that device, edit the Jellyfin connection, enter your password, and save. You do not need to add the connection again.
- Store and Flatpak updates may arrive separately.

## Known issues

- No new known issues.

## Thanks

- [@tobycell12-beep](https://github.com/tobycell12-beep) reported the Jellyfin sign-out and playback failures. Welcome, and thank you for your first contribution to Naviamp!
